sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Bukijutsu, Fuinjutsu,  Earth Release, Water Release

system.description:
You bring to life a single root, manipulating it as it bends to your will. Select a point you can see within range and make a ranged Ninjutsu attack against all creatures within a 5-foot cube originating from the select point comparing your result to their AC as the root bursts forth from the ground like spears.

On a hit, you deal 3d6 Earth, Cold or Chakra damage and each affected creature must make a Dexterity saving throw to avoid being pierced by the roots. On a failed save, they are Grappled in place. A creature that fails by 5 or more is instead Restrained in place.

A creatures grappled or restrained by this jutsu makes a Strength saving throw at the end of their turns, ending either condition on a success.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, and the damage by 1d6. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, increase the size of the cube by +5 feet. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, increase size of the cube by +5 feet.
